descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
📣 Would you like to join a company that puts people at the heart of its concerns? We are waiting for you! Since 2007, Extia, an IT consulting company, has been offering a unique approach in its field by combining well-being at work and performance.
 Our philosophy at Extia is “First who, then what", so let's go for it!
 🚀First who?
Passionate about digital transformation, you have a strong analytical mindset and are truly data-oriented. 
You are a team player who excels in cooperation, easily managing multiple interfaces and IT resources in an international context. 
With a quality-minded and proactive approach, you are a problem-solver who brings strong attention to detail. 
Customer-oriented, you have excellent communication and presentation skills to seamlessly translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
 Our current roles are hybrid, requiring 2-3 days per week in the office (Bucharest). 
 🚀Then what?
 Senior Data Engineer with PowerBI, with the following tasks:
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand data requirements, KPIs, and support their data infrastructure needs. 
Design, develop, and optimize interactive, visually appealing dashboards and reports using Power BI. 
Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources, maintaining pipelines and ETLs in operational condition. 
Perform data analysis to identify trends and effectively communicate insights to executive, product, data, and design teams. 
Manage Row Level Security across the data chain and contribute to data governance and security policies. 
Build Data Cubes and work with modern data architectures (including the Medallion architecture and Data Lakes). 
Handle technical framing (feasibility studies, estimation of load/timeframe), write technical specifications, and ensure documentation of achievements. Provide training, user support, and assist with data-related technical issues.
 Required technical skills:
Proficiency in Power BI, data visualization principles, and data modeling concepts. 
Advanced SQL, DAX, MDX, and Query performance tuning skills. 
Familiarity with fully automated CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Gitlab) for code deployment, testing, and release. 
Strong understanding of distributed query engines (Trino) and object storage systems (MinIO).
Proficiency with tools such as Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Dax Studio, and Tabular Editor. 
Solid knowledge of Agile methodologies and SSAS.
 Nice to have: Experience developing and operating Talend Jobs (or similar ETLs) and relevant certifications in Power BI or data analytics.
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the "Who" and represent the "What"? Apply and let's talk!
